card.name: Words before a change in drug levels
card.fires_on: Words that start or continue a statement about how a pharmacokinetic value changed, such as 'the' before renal clearance, 'concentration' after plasma, or the start of a drug name before C max. Strongest in interaction text where one value rose or fell by an amount.

modes.label: Second half of a paired change
modes.description: Linking word after 'and' that introduces a second measure that also changed.
modes.example: The mean minimum lithium concentration increased 15% and<< the>> renal clearance was decreased by approximately 2
